title: Test plan · Week 1 · v1
sub: 3 tests, $182 test budget for the week
headline: Week 1 plan fixes the over-target Fountain ad (ev-w1-ad_2-week) with easy-clean ceramic, iterates the efficient walk-test (ev-d7-test_1-readout at 0.63 of target) with comfort-first control, and runs one exploratory style test to expand harness appeal beyond the current winner (ev-w1-ad_1-week).

content.summary: Week 1 plan fixes the over-target Fountain ad (ev-w1-ad_2-week) with easy-clean ceramic, iterates the efficient walk-test (ev-d7-test_1-readout at 0.63 of target) with comfort-first control, and runs one exploratory style test to expand harness appeal beyond the current winner (ev-w1-ad_1-week).

tests.name: Fountain Easy-Clean Refresh
tests.hypothesis: Replacing generic quiet-pump claim with ceramic easy-clean + quiet + tip-resistant benefits will lower fountain cost per result toward the $16 target.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost_per_result > $16 after $80 spend or 7 days, or 0 purchases after 2x target spend.

brief.hook: A quiet ceramic sip station that's quick to rinse and nice to look at.
brief.key_message: Non-porous ceramic is easier to keep clean than scratched plastic, with a quiet pump and tip-resistant weight for the cat water fountain.

tests.name: Harness Comfort-Control Iterate
tests.hypothesis: Building on the efficient walk-test at $10.12 (0.63 of target), a comfort-first control creative will keep harness cost under target and add learning on front-clip + breathable mesh.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost_per_result > $16 after $80 spend or 7 days; keep if cost stays under target with 10+ results.

brief.hook: A calmer walk in a comfy, glow-after-dark harness — find your fit.
brief.key_message: Front-clip redirection plus breathable padded mesh and reflective strips for comfy day-and-night walks with the no-pull dog harness.

tests.name: Harness Style Explore
tests.hypothesis: A design-led, soft adjustable everyday-wear angle will attract style-sensitive dog owners as a new segment beyond the studio carousel winner.
tests.stop_rule: Pause exploratory if cost_per_result > $18 after $60 spend or 7 days; evaluate for new audience interest if CTR holds.

brief.hook: Soft, stretchy and photo-ready — gear for everyday adventures.
brief.key_message: Soft adjustable everyday wear with multiple clip points and a comfortable fit for the dog harness, built for everyday walks.
